_readme: 2026 Sec 1-3 EOY items, by language|course|sec, for the Core skills End point column. Taken on 18 Nov 2026 from the HOD's '20261119 MTL S1-4 EOY Item Progression.xlsx' (pre-read for the 19 Nov 2026 MTL dept meeting, a DRAFT): CL = the CL Test Item Progression references agreed at the CL Whitespace meetings of 20 and 22 Jul 2026; ML = 2026 ML EOY TOS sheets, mark-entry templates and W4 cluster specs; TL = the 2026 TL S1-3 EOY papers (BVSS and Cluster West). Item types and marks only; no questions. 'a' = the CL reference's own alignment with SEAB.
